_readme: Explore Colorado destinations on the homepage. Photos are from Wikimedia Commons under the licenses shown; keep each credit with its photo. Run tools/build_properties.py after editing.

destinations.name: Union Station
destinations.text: Denver’s restored 1914 rail hall is the city’s living room: a Great Hall to linger in, coffee by day, cocktails by night, and trains to the airport and beyond.
destinations.alt: Denver Union Station lit up for the holidays at dusk, with its neon Travel by Train sign

destinations.name: Larimer Square
destinations.text: Denver’s most historic block, strung with lights and Colorado flags and lined with Victorian storefronts, chef-driven restaurants and patio dining.
destinations.alt: Larimer Square in Denver, a historic red-brick block hung with Colorado flags and string lights

destinations.name: LoDo
destinations.text: Red-brick warehouses reborn as breweries, galleries and restaurants. Wynkoop Brewing, Colorado’s first brewpub, anchors the neighborhood.
destinations.alt: Wynkoop Brewing Company in a red-brick warehouse building in Lower Downtown Denver

destinations.name: 16th Street
destinations.text: A tree-lined pedestrian promenade through the heart of downtown, with shops, patios and street life from Union Station toward Civic Center.
destinations.alt: Pedestrians on the tree-lined 16th Street Mall in downtown Denver on a summer day

destinations.name: Coors Field
destinations.text: Home of the Colorado Rockies. Catch a summer night game, then walk out into the bars and restaurants of the Ballpark neighborhood.
destinations.alt: Coors Field in Denver lit up during a Colorado Rockies night game

destinations.name: RiNo Art District
destinations.text: Murals on nearly every block, converted warehouses, food halls and breweries in Denver’s most creative neighborhood.
destinations.alt: Large black-and-white sea serpent mural by the artist RUMTUM covering a building in the RiNo Art District, Denver

destinations.name: The Highlands
destinations.text: Cross the Highland Bridge from downtown to Victorian streets, rooftop restaurants and some of the best skyline views in the city.
destinations.alt: People crossing the Highland Bridge pedestrian bridge toward the Denver skyline at dusk

destinations.name: Cherry Creek
destinations.text: Denver’s polished shopping and dining district, with boutiques, galleries and the summer Cherry Creek Arts Festival.
destinations.alt: Crowds walking among tents at the Cherry Creek Arts Festival in Denver

destinations.name: Red Rocks Amphitheatre
destinations.text: A world-famous open-air venue set between towering sandstone monoliths in the foothills west of Denver. Come for a concert, stay for the sunset.
destinations.alt: Red Rocks Amphitheatre seating between giant red sandstone rocks under a blue Colorado sky

destinations.name: The Rockies on the horizon
destinations.text: Denver sits at the edge of the Front Range, so mountain trails, ski towns and scenic drives make easy day trips from a furnished home in the city.
destinations.alt: Downtown Denver skyline with the snow-capped Rocky Mountains on the horizon

credit.by: Carol M. Highsmith, Library of Congress
